description: Ministry of Higher Education and Highways - Order to amend the Order published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1567/23 of 19.09.2008 specifying the Faculties and the Departments of the University of Ruhuna, by the substitution ''Department of Limnology and Water, Technology" for "Department of Limnology".
categorisation: This gazette notification involves an amendment to university departmental structure (changing "Department of Limnology" to "Department of Limnology and Water Technology") under the Universities Act. While it references a minister (Lakshman Kiriella), it does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities. The content specifically deals with educational/academic matters (university departmental structure), which falls under the Miscellaneous category (Type 10) for educational matters not covered by other specialized types.
